title: Garbage collection
text: Garbage collection is an important java engineering concept used in production software systems. Engineers should understand its purpose, operating behavior, trade-offs, failure modes, configuration, and appropriate use cases. Good implementations rely on measurement, clear boundaries, safe defaults, testing, and operational monitoring rather than treating the technique as a universal solution.
